description: Behaviour of ./sandbox.sh test. The Bash implementation in ASF v49 lib/security_test.sh was captured byte for byte before its body was removed; these values are the contract for asf.security. {PREFIX} is the checkout resource prefix and {SANDBOX} the physical checkout path.
notes: 13 of 17 vectors are byte-identical to Bash. The remaining ones carry a `divergence` note and keep the Bash bytes alongside as bash_*; every one of them is an infrastructure-failure scenario, where Bash could not tell a probe that failed to run from a policy decision.
No scenario in which Bash passed now fails, and no scenario in which Bash failed now passes: the divergences change what a failure says, and in infra-inspect-fails how many checks it counts.

The engine is a scripted fake (tests/reference/fake_podman_security.py). Each vector's `exec` table is matched in order against the joined in-container command, so one probe can fail while every other check still runs.

manifests.proxy-agent:
name: proxy-agent
adapter: generic
llm:
  broker: true
  protocol: anthropic
  provider: anthropic
  api_key_env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
  direct_domain: api.anthropic.com
secrets:
  files:
    - proxy-agent.env
network:
  mode: proxy
  allow_domains:
    - api.anthropic.com
    - statsig.com
    - sentry.io
  verify_domain: statsig.com
manifests.bare-proxy:
name: bare-proxy
adapter: generic
network:
  mode: proxy
manifests.isolated-agent:
name: isolated-agent
adapter: generic
network:
  mode: isolated
manifests.routed-agent:
name: routed-agent
adapter: generic
capabilities:
  - net_raw
network:
  mode: routed
  allow:
    - cidr: 192.0.2.10/32
      protocol: tcp
      ports: [18080]
  verify:
    address: 192.0.2.10
    protocol: tcp
    port: 18080
    blocked_port: 19999
